mapper.sql: SELECT su.USER_ID as "uid", su.SYSTEM_CODE as systemCode, su.USER_NAME as userName, su.REAL_NAME as realName, su.MAIL_ADDR as mailAddr, su.PHONE_NUM as phoneNum, su.SSO_USER_ID as ssoUserId, su.ADMIN_FLAG as adminFlag, su.IS_FROZEN as isFrozen, su.WECHAT_NUM as wechatNum, sdept.DEPT_CODE as deptCode, sdept.DEPT_NAME as deptName, sinst.INSTITUTION_CODE as orgCode, sinst.INSTITUTION_NAME as orgName FROM SYS_USER su LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sdept ON su.DEPT_CODE = sdept.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SYS_INSTITUTION sinst ON (sdept.INSTITUTION_CODE = sinst.INSTITUTION_CODE OR (sinst.INSTITUTION_CODE = su.DEPT_CODE AND sdept.DEPT_CODE IS NULL))
mapper.select: inner join SYS_USER_ROLE sur on sur.USER_ID = su.USER_NAME and ROLE_ID = #{roleId}

select.if: LEFT JOIN VW_DATA_AUTH_INSTITUTION VDAI ON VDAI.INSTITUTION_CODE = sdept.institution_code and VDAI.CODE_TYPE ='inst'

mapper.select: SELECT SYS_USER.USER_ID as "uid", SYS_USER.SYSTEM_CODE as systemCode, SYS_USER.USER_NAME as userName, SYS_USER.REAL_NAME as realName, SYS_USER.MAIL_ADDR as mailAddr, SYS_USER.PHONE_NUM as phoneNum, SYS_USER.PASSWORD as password, SYS_USER.SALT as salt, SYS_USER.SSO_USER_ID as ssoUserId, SYS_USER.ADMIN_FLAG as adminFlag, SYS_USER.IS_FROZEN as isFrozen, SYS_USER.WECHAT_NUM as wechatNum, SYS_USER.LAST_PASS_DATE as lastPassDate, SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE as deptCode, SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_NAME as deptName, SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_CODE as orgCode, SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_NAME as orgName FROM SYS_USER LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT ON SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE = SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SYS_INSTITUTION ON (SYS_DEPARTMENT.INSTITUTION_CODE = SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_CODE OR (SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_CODE = SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE AND SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE IS NULL)) WHERE SYS_USER.USER_NAME = #{username, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT SYS_USER.USER_ID as "uid", SYS_USER.SYSTEM_CODE as systemCode, SYS_USER.USER_NAME as userName, SYS_USER.REAL_NAME as realName, SYS_USER.MAIL_ADDR as mailAddr, SYS_USER.PHONE_NUM as phoneNum, SYS_USER.PASSWORD as password, SYS_USER.SALT as salt, SYS_USER.SSO_USER_ID as ssoUserId, SYS_USER.ADMIN_FLAG as adminFlag, SYS_USER.IS_FROZEN as isFrozen, SYS_USER.WECHAT_NUM as wechatNum, SYS_USER.LAST_PASS_DATE as lastPassDate, SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE as deptCode, SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_NAME as deptName, SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_CODE as orgCode, SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_NAME as orgName FROM SYS_USER LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT ON SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE = SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SYS_INSTITUTION ON (SYS_DEPARTMENT.INSTITUTION_CODE = SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_CODE OR (SYS_INSTITUTION.INSTITUTION_CODE = SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE AND SYS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_CODE IS NULL)) WHERE UPPER(SYS_USER.USER_NAME) = UPPER(#{username, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
